verdict.rationale: Persona is an identity-verification SaaS that stores sensitive end-user data, so choosing a data region or residency is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents selecting a storage region or residency. The IP allowlist and webhook attribute blocklists are adjacent security controls, not data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
